Papers where I am [first author]{.role-label .role-first} or [last author]{.role-label .role-last} are marked, including joint first and joint last authorship.

```{=html}
<label class="pub-filter"><input type="checkbox" id="pub-filter"> Show only first- and last-author papers</label>
<script>
document.getElementById("pub-filter").addEventListener("change", function () {
  document.body.classList.toggle("pub-filtered", this.checked);
  document.querySelectorAll("section.level2").forEach(function (sec) {
    var any = sec.querySelector(".pub-first, .pub-last");
    sec.classList.toggle("pub-empty", this.checked && !any);
  }, this);
});
</script>
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("R/publications.R")
groups <- pub_groups(read_publications())
for (heading in names(groups)) {
  cat("\n## ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(pub_list_html(groups[[heading]]), "\n")
}
```
